text.name: Cinderace

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Explosiveness
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in your hand when you are setting up to play, you may put it face down in the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Turbo Flare
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

text.name: Hariyama

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Heave-Ho Catcher
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Wild Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

text.name: Lunatone

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Lunar Cycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic {Fighting} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn.

text.flavor: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

text.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Cosmic Beam
attacks.text: If you don't have Lunatone on your Bench, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

text.name: Boss’s Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Fighting Gong
effect: Search your deck for a Basic {Fighting} Energy card or a Basic {Fighting} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Forest of Vitality
effect: Each player’s {Grass} Pokémon can evolve into {Grass} Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

text.name: Iron Defender
effect: During your opponent’s next turn, all of your {Metal} Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Lillie’s Determination
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Mega Signal
effect: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Mystery Garden
effect: Once during each player’s turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have {Psychic} Pokémon in play.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

text.name: Premium Power Pro
effect: During this turn, attacks used by your {Fighting} Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Strange Timepiece
effect: Devolve 1 of your evolved {Psychic} Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can’t evolve this turn.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Surfing Beach
effect: Once during each player’s turn, that player may switch their Active {Water} Pokémon with 1 of their Benched {Water} Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

text.name: Wally's Compassion
effect: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Eelektrik

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {Lightning} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Metallic Signal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Evolution {Metal} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Air Balloon
effect: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {Colorless}{Colorless} less.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool rule
rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

text.name: Emboar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Inferno Fandango
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {Fire} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

text.name: Shaymin

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flower Curtain
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

text.flavor: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Golden Flame
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {Fire} Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Ethan's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shining Feathers
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from each of your Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Team Rocket’s Petrel
effect: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Fairy Zone
abilities.text: The Weakness of each of your opponent's {Dragon} Pokémon in play is now {Psychic}. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Archaludon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Metal Bridge
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have {Metal} Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Iron Blaster
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

text.flavor: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.
